name: Sticky Banner
author: Dave Meier

sections.description:
Boost conversions and grab visitor attention with a customizable sticky banner!

Sticky Banner is the easiest way to display important announcements, promotions, or calls-to-action on your WordPress website. Whether you’re running a sale, announcing an event, or collecting email signups, this lightweight plugin helps you get noticed without slowing down your site.

Why Choose Sticky Banner?

  • Lightning Fast – Optimized code that won’t slow down your website
  • Super Easy Setup – Configure your banner in minutes, no coding required
  • Live Preview – See exactly how your banner looks before publishing
  • Fully Customizable – Match your brand with custom colors and messaging
  • Mobile Responsive – Looks perfect on all devices and screen sizes
  • User-Friendly – Visitors can dismiss the banner, and it won’t show again for a set number of days
  • Smart Display Controls – Hide the banner on specific pages
  • SEO Friendly – Semantic HTML and accessibility features built-in
  • Translation Ready – Fully internationalized and ready for translation

Perfect For

  • Product launches and special offers
  • Holiday sales and promotions
  • Event announcements
  • Newsletter signups
  • Cookie notices and GDPR compliance
  • Important site-wide announcements
  • Limited-time deals
  • Lead generation campaigns

Key Features

  • Easy enable/disable toggle – Show or hide banner without losing your settings
  • Position banner at top or bottom of your site
  • Custom colors for background, text, and buttons
  • Add a call-to-action button with custom text and link
  • Set cookie expiration (control how long banner stays hidden after dismissal)
  • Hide close button for critical announcements that must be seen
  • Exclude specific pages by ID
  • Clean, modern design that works with any theme
  • Fully responsive and mobile-optimized
  • No jQuery conflicts
  • Clean uninstall (removes all data when deleted)

Premium Support

While this plugin is completely free, we offer premium support and custom development services. Visit Hidden Depth for more information.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Sticky Banner”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Sticky Banner in your admin sidebar
  6. Check the “Show sticky banner on site” box to enable the banner
  7. Configure your banner settings and click “Save Changes”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file from WordPress.org
  2. Log in to your WordPress dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Click “Activate Plugin”
  6. Go to Sticky Banner in your admin sidebar
  7. Check the “Show sticky banner on site” box and configure your settings

FTP Installation

  1. Download and extract the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the hdsb-stickybanner folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Go to Sticky Banner in your admin sidebar
  5. Check the “Show sticky banner on site” box and configure your settings
sections.faq:
How do I create my first banner?

After activating the plugin, go to Sticky Banner in your WordPress admin sidebar. Check the “Show sticky banner on site” box to enable it, enter your announcement text, choose your colors, add an optional call-to-action button, and click Save Changes. You’ll see a live preview as you configure!

Can I change the position of the banner?

Yes! You can choose to display the banner at either the top or bottom of your website. Simply select your preferred position in the plugin settings.

How do I add a call-to-action button?

In the Sticky Banner settings, enter your button text in the “Button Text” field and add your destination URL in the “Button Link” field. The button will automatically appear on your banner.

How do I temporarily hide the banner without deleting my settings?

Simply uncheck the “Show sticky banner on site” box at the top of the settings page and click Save Changes. This will hide the banner from your website while preserving all your configuration (text, colors, button settings, etc.). Check the box again whenever you want to show it.

Can visitors close the banner?

Yes! The banner includes a close button (×) that visitors can click. Once closed, the banner won’t show again for the number of days you specify in the “Cookie Expiry” setting (default is 7 days).

How do I hide the banner on specific pages?

You can exclude specific pages by entering their page IDs (separated by commas) in the “Hide on Pages” field. To find a page ID, edit the page in WordPress and look for post= in the URL bar.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

No! Sticky Banner is optimized for performance. It only loads minimal CSS and JavaScript, and only on pages where the banner is displayed. Scripts are deferred and cached properly.

Is the banner mobile-responsive?

Absolutely! The banner is fully responsive and looks great on all devices, from desktop computers to mobile phones.

Can I use HTML in my announcement text?

Yes, basic HTML is allowed in the announcement text field, so you can add formatting like bold text, links, etc.

Does the plugin work with my theme?

Yes! Sticky Banner is designed to work with any well-coded WordPress theme. The banner uses semantic HTML and doesn’t interfere with theme styles.

Is the plugin translation-ready?

Yes! Sticky Banner is fully internationalized and ready for translation into any language.

How do I change the banner colors?

Use the color pickers in the plugin settings to customize both the background color and text color. You’ll see a live preview of your changes.

What happens to my data if I uninstall the plugin?

If you deactivate the plugin, your settings are preserved. If you delete the plugin entirely, all settings are automatically removed from your database to keep it clean.

Can I use this for cookie notices or GDPR compliance?

While you can use Sticky Banner to display cookie notices, please note that it doesn’t include specific GDPR compliance features. For full GDPR compliance, consider using a dedicated cookie consent plugin.

Where can I get support?

For support questions, please use the WordPress.org support forums. For premium support and custom development, visit Hidden Depth.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0 – 2025-11-11

Comprehensive Update: Security, Performance, Compatibility & Best Practices

This version builds upon 1.3.x security improvements with even more comprehensive enhancements, bringing the plugin to modern WordPress standards with enterprise-grade security, optimal performance, and full accessibility compliance.

Major Enhancements:
* NEW: Hide close button option for critical announcements
* Integrated all improvements from versions 1.3.0 and 1.3.1
* Further enhanced security beyond 1.3 improvements
* Comprehensive performance optimizations
* Full WordPress 6.7+ compatibility
* Complete internationalization support
* PHP 7.4-8.4 compatibility verified and documented
* Professional documentation and monetization roadmap

Security Improvements:
* Fixed multiple XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) vulnerabilities
* Added proper input sanitization for all user inputs
* Added output escaping for all displayed content
* Implemented CSRF protection with nonce verification
* Added capability checks using ‘manage_options’
* Prevented direct file access to all PHP files
* Fixed CSS injection vulnerabilities
* Added proper URL validation and sanitization

Performance Improvements:
* Optimized script loading – only loads on pages where banner is displayed
* Converted inline JavaScript to wp_add_inline_script for better caching
* Converted inline CSS to wp_add_inline_style for better performance
* Added conditional loading based on settings
* Improved code efficiency and reduced redundancy
* Better script dependency management

WordPress Compatibility:
* Updated to work with WordPress 6.7+
* Increased minimum PHP requirement to 7.4
* Increased minimum WordPress requirement to 5.0
* Added full internationalization support (i18n)
* Added text domain for translations
* Improved accessibility with ARIA labels

User Experience:
* Better admin interface with improved labels and descriptions
* Changed close button from div to semantic button element
* Added rel=”noopener noreferrer” to external links
* Improved admin UI with better descriptions
* Changed dashboard icon to more appropriate megaphone icon
* Better default values and fallbacks

Code Quality:
* Added proper WordPress coding standards
* Improved code documentation
* Added uninstall.php for clean plugin removal
* Better error handling and validation
* Removed unused code
* Added strict type comparisons

1.3.1 – 2024-XX-XX

  • Edit: Align text and button on mobile/small screens
  • Improved responsive design for better mobile experience

1.3.0 – 2024-XX-XX

  • Add: Enhanced security with sanitization callbacks
  • Add: Nonce field verification for form submissions
  • Add: Capability checks with manage_options
  • Edit: Modular JavaScript approach for better maintainability
  • Edit: Simplified file structure
  • Tested up to WordPress 6.5.2

1.2.0 – 2024-XX-XX

  • Tested up to WordPress 6.5.2
  • Made button style more button-like
  • Resolved admin button hover text issue

1.1.0 – 2020-02-15

The plugin has been coded from the ground up to be cleaner and make future updates easier.

  • New setting: Cookie expiry days option added to settings
  • New setting: Hide on pages option added (add page IDs with commas)
  • New: Adds an active class to the body for styling (hdsb-t-active or hdsb-b-active)
  • New: Users can now close banner with X on right hand side (adds cookie for 7 days)
  • Update: Button will not show without a URL added to settings

1.0.0 – 2020-01-10

  • Initial release
